response.overview: Early and accurate diagnosis is the first step toward the right treatment. We review biopsies, scans, and reports to confirm the cancer type, stage, and spread before building a focused treatment plan. Reconstructive Surgery Oral cancer surgery can affect appearance and function. Our reconstructive procedures restore the shape and usability of affected areas, helping patients regain confidence, normal speech, and the ability to eat comfortably after treatment. Surgeries for Advanced Oral & Neck Cancer Advanced-stage oral and neck cancers require experienced surgical judgment. We perform complex resections and neck dissections for cases where cancer has spread beyond the primary site or involves surrounding structures. Microvascular Reconstructive Surgery When large tissue areas are removed during cancer surgery, microvascular free flap reconstruction rebuilds them using tissue from another part of the body. This technique restores both function and form with greater precision.
